topics.label: Course introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the scope, learning objectives, and interdisciplinary context of the cancer biology lecture series.

topics.label: Cellular, developmental, and experimental foundations of cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe cancer as a multistep breakdown of normal cellular differentiation and tissue architecture, alongside the laboratory models used to study it.

topics.label: Benign versus malignant tumors, invasion, and nomenclature
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the pathological and clinical differences between benign and malignant neoplasms, detailing how local invasion, metastasis, and progression develop and are systematically classified.

topics.label: Mechanisms of disease, mortality, and comparative incidence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address how tumors cause morbidity and mortality, comparing their epidemiological occurrence across human tissues and other multicellular organisms.

topics.label: Clinical presentation and cancer screening strategies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the signs with which tumors present clinically and evaluate the principles, histological basis, and effectiveness of screening methods across different tumor types.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and practical reminders
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic wraps up the lecture with a summary reminder of the learning outcomes and practical coursework.
